name: What design trends are popular for kitchen refreshes right now?

mainEntity.name: What design trends are popular for kitchen refreshes right now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current kitchen refresh trends emphasize a blend of aesthetics and practicality. Popular choices include two-tone cabinetry with contrasting upper and lower cabinets, often featuring deep blues or greens on the bottom and lighter shades on top. Matte finishes for hardware and appliances remain popular, offering a sophisticated touch. Quartz countertops continue to be a favorite for their durability and low maintenance, often in natural-looking patterns. Integrated smart home technology and efficient storage solutions are also highly sought after, alongside open shelving for a lighter, more airy feel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular kitchen refresh trends include two-tone cabinetry, matte finishes, quartz countertops, smart tech, and open shelving.
